Take a slow walk through the winter forest at night, listening for flying squirrel calls and looking for feeding marks, while you wait to spot them gliding from tree to tree.

【Fees】Adults: ¥6,000 | Students: ¥5,000 | Preschool children: ¥3,000 (includes guide, insurance, materials)

【Capacity】10 people

【Guide】Forest Field Study Hall (Mori no Manabiya) staff

【What to bring】Rain gear • drinking water • warm clothing • flashlight to light your footing • snack food

【More information】Forest Field Study Hall website: https://morinomanabiya168.wixsite.com/website
